event.description: Retest d14 ff22 with rank8 positions and zero decay
event.proposal: family: feed-forward width; current retained incumbent is 2884 parameters at 99.9900%, a +0.99 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0044, d14/ff23 at 2982/99.97% under standard decay; same-family failed result: attempt-0045, d14/ff22 at 2926/9.79% under standard decay; prior attempts in this family: 13. The later rank9-to-rank8 positional trials showed that removing AdamW weight decay can turn a near miss into 99.99–100%, so retest the same ff22 width with the retained rank8 positional factor and weight_decay=0.0, yielding 2828 parameters. This is more informative than moving to ff21 because it isolates the newly identified training-control variable at the nearest failed FF boundary; the nearest untested alternative is a larger optimizer change that would confound width and regularization. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2884 parameters.
